messages:
ravi: heads-up: onboarding v3.2-quant-lite into staggered canary. latency + cost look great but early evals show degraded factuality on instruction-following probes. starting thread to decide gating.
anna: which probes failing? general QA, multi-step reasoning, or extraction?
ravi: mostly extraction and list-enumeration tasks (answers missing list items). single-turn QA OK. sample set: https://internal.redwood/samples/4218887776-extracts
jorge: are these real traffic slices or synthetic evals? need slice weight before auto actions.
ravi: synthetic probe run + 8k shadow requests from production-mirroring (2% traffic). affected slice label: "extract/list" ~2.2% traffic.
sylvie: any token-distribution shifts or logprob deltas?
ravi: token-logprob mean down 0.06; answer-coverage metric delta -7% absolute. bootstrap CI looks tight.
ops-bot: deploybot: staggered canary start 4218887800 region-us-east
anna: propose ensemble-sanity gate: require both metric-level and behavior-level checks. metric gate: answer-coverage delta <= -5% AND token-logprob shift <= -0.04 triggers investigation. behavior gate: if top-k disagreement with control > 12% for extract slice then pause promotion.
jorge: add stabilization: need 3 consecutive eval windows (5m each) to auto-trigger. also require min_samples 1500 for the slice.
sylvie: safety: never auto-fallback if latency tail improved (we want perf wins), but do create immediate pager if factuality delta > -10%.
ravi: draft YAML: 
```yaml
gate:
  name: ensemble-sanity-extract-gate
  windows: 3
  metrics:
    - name: answer_coverage
      comparator: delta_pct
      threshold: -5
      min_samples: 1500
    - name: mean_logprob
      comparator: delta
      threshold: -0.04
  behavior_checks:
    - name: topk_disagreement
      comparator: absolute_pct
      threshold: 12
      slices: ["extract/list"]
  safety:
    immediate_page_threshold: -10
    require_latency_ok: false
  action:
    on_violation: pause_promotion_and_notify
    notify: ["#oncall", "#ops"]
    manual_review_required: true
```
anna: small tweak: use normalized answer_coverage (normalize by reference length) and require bootstrap CI not overlapping zero. also add cooldown 2h after manual override.
jorge: agree. can we add an automated microshadow that re-runs failing samples through a variant with kv-ttl longer to rule out warmup?
sylvie: yes schedule microshadow 30k for tonight with ttl=120s. if microshadow fixes >80% of failures, flag as warmup cause not model degradation.
eval-bot: eval-bot: window1: answer_coverage delta -6.8% (95% CI [-8.1,-5.5]), mean_logprob -0.055, topk_disagreement 13.4%, affected slice weight 2.2%
ravi: CI crosses threshold and behavior check violated -> gate tripped. manual review required. tagging @anna @jorge
anna: opening incident ticket and pausing further ramp. will attach diffs and start microshadow.
sylvie: logging gate config and eval outputs to canary repo. follow-up after microshadow results.
